facts.fact: 2424.mg reports that the bill on access to public information (LAICP), conceived in 2006, was adopted by the Council of Ministers on Wednesday 3 December 2025 and is due to go to Parliament.
facts.system: projet de loi sur l'accès à l'information à caractère public (LAICP)

MDG.note: The early-November consultation on the bill is not said to have run online.
The consultation concerned an access to information bill, not a named digital law or policy.
